integrity: Explicit analytical derivation and finite reproducibility tests are included; only self-review performed, no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive finite-period scalar weights on complex bilateral ell-two; no nonperiodic or noncommuting generality, no period-uniform constants or full classification of exceptional profiles. title: A universal sharp nonlinear spectral rate for cyclic induced Aluthge means
